decisions.decision: Atomic-rename save path uses tmp_dest.suffix + .tmp + os.replace
decisions.rationale: Original shutil.move + unlink(missing_ok=True) destroyed user files on partial failure
Per-row increment let batch_done fire after row 1 of N

decisions.decision: Windows process kill via taskkill /F /T /PID — no psutil dependency
decisions.rationale: Avoid new dep; taskkill is built-in and kills full process tree
Download/save failures occur after URL is confirmed valid; flipping them to invalid card corrupts user semantic
UNC path is_dir() per keystroke froze UI for ~21s on offline SMB
update_row_metadata.update_row_status is a method call, not a signal emit; _refresh_start_button depends on the explicit row_status_changed emit to enable Start button after METADATA_READY transition
PySide6 typed event dispatch may bypass Python attribute lookup; monkey-patch was fragile
